Home.eyebrow: A place at a real table in Istanbul
Home.title: Come for dinner. Leave knowing the household.
Home.intro: Reserve a seat at a scheduled dinner inside a verified Turkish home. The household chooses the menu, sits with you, and makes time for tea and conversation.
Home.trustOneText: Every household and traveler capacity is reviewed by Sofra before publication.
Home.trustTwoText: The household shares the dinner it has chosen. Dietary needs are checked privately for compatibility.
Home.trustThreeText: A verified host joins the dinner or the tea-and-conversation period—always.
Home.nextIntro: Specific homes, specific evenings, and a clear sense of who will be at the table.
Home.storyEyebrow: This is how dinner happens in our home.
Home.storyTitle: Not a performance. Not a restaurant. A household welcoming you in.
Home.storyBody: Each home has its own rhythm, stories, and idea of a generous table. Sofra protects that difference while setting clear standards for safety, privacy, and hosting.
Home.rhythmTitle: The evening has room to breathe
rhythm: A household dessert or fruit tradition

How.eyebrow: A managed marketplace, from invitation to goodbye
How.title: What it means to join a Sofra table
How.intro: The household creates the evening. Sofra verifies the home, approves the scheduled table, protects private information, and supports both sides.

steps.title: Choose a scheduled table
steps.body: Browse a particular household, date, complete menu, table format, capacity, languages, and atmosphere.

steps.title: Share needs privately
steps.body: Tell Sofra about allergies, restrictions, or preferences. The question is whether the existing menu is compatible—not how to customize it.

steps.title: Reserve the whole experience
steps.body: See one all-inclusive price before checkout. Shared tables sell seats; private tables are kept for your party.

steps.title: Receive arrival details safely
steps.body: Public pages show only an approximate neighborhood. Exact arrival information appears only at the appropriate confirmed stage.

steps.title: Join dinner and stay for tea
steps.body: A verified host participates meaningfully, with space after dinner for Turkish tea or coffee and real conversation.

standards: Separate public reviews, private feedback, and safety reports
No guest selection by appearance or sensitive traits

Discovery.title: Find the evening that feels right
Discovery.intro: Every listing is a particular dinner—not a generic host profile. Explore the menu, household, format, timing, and atmosphere before you choose.

Table.menuNote: The household chooses the complete menu. Private disclosures help determine compatibility; they do not create a custom order.
Table.participants: Who from the household will join
Table.whereNote: The pin represents the approximate neighborhood. The exact home address is never public.
Table.noneJoining: No other parties have booked yet.
Table.priceIncludes: One all-inclusive price. No service fee appears later.
Table.minimumNote: This shared table needs at least {count} travelers before it is confirmed.
Table.exactAddress: Exact arrival details are shared only at the appropriate confirmed-booking stage.

HostRecruit.title: Share the dinner that already belongs to your home.
HostRecruit.intro: You choose the menu, the story, the dates, and the desired net payout. Sofra verifies the household, certifies capacity, approves every table, and supports safe hosting.
HostRecruit.participationBody: At least one verified adult host sits with travelers for dinner or the tea-and-conversation period. Hosting is not only cooking and serving.

Auth.title: Sign in to Sofra
Auth.intro: We’ll send a secure magic link to your email. No password is required.
Auth.demoNote: Remote authentication is not connected in demo mode. Use the demo personas to explore protected foundations.
Auth.verifyBody: Open the link we sent to finish signing in. You can close this page after the link opens.

Booking.title: Request {menuTitle}
Booking.dietaryHelp: Used only to assess this household’s existing menu. Never shared publicly or sent to analytics.
Booking.compatibility: I understand Sofra and the household must confirm menu compatibility.
Booking.policy: I understand the household chooses the menu, the exact address is private, and a shared table may need a minimum number of travelers.
Booking.disabledBody: Your reservation details can be reviewed, but Sofra cannot accept payment in this environment. No booking has been marked paid and no card details were requested.
Booking.mockBody: Local simulation is enabled. No card information will be collected.

Demo.title: Choose a local demo persona
Demo.intro: These personas are available only in local development. They set an HTTP-only demo session and never grant production access.

States.unauthorizedTitle: This area needs a different account role
States.unauthorizedBody: Choose an appropriate demo persona locally, or sign in with an authorized Sofra account when Supabase is connected.
States.notFoundTitle: That table is no longer available
States.notFoundBody: It may have filled, passed its booking cutoff, or returned to review.
States.errorTitle: We couldn’t set the table just now
States.errorBody: Nothing was charged. Please return to the available tables and try again.
